transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope it's okay that I came in for this. It's probably just me needing to try a little harder, but... I've been having some trouble keeping things straight lately. 

I'm taking some classes, and I also run this little accessories shop, which is really fun, but I just feel like I cannot get my schoolwork and my shop organized at the same time. Like, my crafting supplies, the due dates for my classes, my receipts, and my assignment notes... they all just sort of end up in these big piles everywhere. And then I just look at it all and I don't even know what to do first. 

It's a bit embarrassing to admit, honestly, because I know I should be able to handle it. Does that... does that make sense as a reason to be here?
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy while dealing with all of this?

Oh, um, no, not really. I mean, I definitely get frustrated with myself sometimes when things get too messy, but I wouldn't say I feel hopeless or down. 

I actually really love what I do! I haven't lost interest in my shop or my classes at all. I'm usually a pretty upbeat person, honestly. I just... I get a little overwhelmed because I want to do all these fun things and I just can't seem to keep it all straight. 

I hope it doesn't seem like I'm complaining too much or making a big deal out of nothing, since I'm not, you know, depressed or anything. Is it still okay that I made an appointment just for the organizing and focus stuff?
Do you find yourself getting easily distracted or avoiding starting tasks, even when you know they're important or need to be done?

Oh, um... no, I don't think so? I hope it's okay to say that. I actually... I usually jump right into things. Like, if I have a new idea for my shop or a project for class, I'm usually really eager to just get started right away. I don't really sit around avoiding them. 

And I wouldn't really say I get distracted, exactly? I mean, I'm always doing a lot of things, so I'm definitely keeping busy! I just, um... I kind of do everything all at the same time, which is why those big piles I mentioned happen. But I'm not, like, avoiding my work or staring out the window or anything. I'm pretty much always on the go. 

I hope that's a helpful answer? I just want to make sure I'm explaining it right for you.
Do you often feel restless, as if you need to be moving or doing something all the time, even when you're trying to relax or focus on just one task?

Um... yeah, I guess I do feel like that sometimes. I hope it doesn't make me sound like a little kid who can't sit still, but... even when I'm not actually going anywhere, I just kind of feel like my body is buzzing? 

Like, I just feel this need to be moving around, especially when I'm in class and I'm supposed to just sit there and listen to the lecture. I try really hard not to be disruptive, I promise! I usually just bounce my leg or play with a pen so I don't bother anyone else. 

It's not that I don't want to relax, it's just... hard for me to just stop, I guess? Is that normal? I mean, I know a lot of people have a lot of energy at my age, so maybe it's just that?
